prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: Pankeki image generation empty state illustration, to be rendered on warm off-white UI at approximately 800 x 390 pixels.
Input image 1: reference and extraction target. It is a full app screenshot; extract/recreate faithfully ONLY its central decorative illustration.
Primary request: create a polished wide 2:1 transparent PNG illustration matching the reference's central pancake and cat drawing. Three thick fluffy golden pancakes on a white ceramic plate, glossy amber maple syrup dripping over edges, a single square pale yellow butter cube on top. Small cute cream white kitten sitting snugly to the LEFT of the plate, simple dark brown eyes and mouth, blush peach cheeks, curled thin tail.
Composition: keep the pancake stack near center-right and the tiny kitten near center-left, with soft airy pale peach brush-like flourish and several subtle peach paw prints around them, four small orange star sparkle accents. Entire illustration centered in wide 2:1 canvas, no clipped edges, generous transparent margins. Match the reference object's proportions and warm hand-drawn storybook sticker illustration style with dark warm brown outlines, smooth painted color, soft shadow.
Constraints: actually transparent background outside the illustrated peach brush and shadows; preserve fine clean alpha edges. No user interface, no app panels, no cards, no thumbnails, no title, no text, no letters, no watermark, no background rectangle. Output only the central pancake-cat illustration.
visual_review: Central pancake stack with syrup and butter, cream kitten left of plate, pale peach flourish and paw prints, four orange sparkle accents. No UI or text. Wide composition; clean transparent surroundings.
